paper.title_en: One-shot achievable rate regions for classical and quantum Sgarro coding
paper.abstract_en: We study one-shot source coding with side information available at two decoders. We first establish one-shot achievable rate bounds for the classical setting by combining smooth information quantities with the one-shot maximal simultaneous code lemma. We then extend the framework to classical source coding with full quantum side information at two decoders. For this setting, we establish a quantum version of the maximal simultaneous code lemma. Finally, we consider a quantum helper variant in which the decoders do not directly access the quantum systems but instead receive coded outcomes from the helpers. By one-shot measurement compression, we derive an achievable rate region. In the asymptotic i.i.d. limit, these one-shot bounds recover the corresponding asymptotic rate bounds.
